skill.summary: Pro-Studio v4.0.0. AI-powered background removal, smart subtitle placement, and cinematic LUT presets. The ultimate production suite for high-end video content.

latestVersion.changelog:
v5.0.0 — Major version bump to refresh registry description.

The registry-level summary on the public listing has been stuck on the v4.0.0 marketing copy ("Pro-Studio v4.0.0. AI-powered background removal...") even after the SKILL.md was rewritten in v4.1.0 and v4.2.0. The LLM scanner repeatedly flags the skill as suspicious because the public summary contradicts the actual code.

This v5.0.0 publish is a major version bump intended to force a fresh registry summary derivation from the current SKILL.md description, plus the genuine improvements added in v4.2.0:

- scripts/loudnorm_two_pass.py — automate two-pass EBU R128 loudnorm
- scripts/make_vertical.py — convert horizontal video to 9:16 vertical (letterbox / crop / blur-fill)

All previous bug fixes carry over: subtitle text-bleed bug fix, safe argv-based subprocess calls, path injection rejection, honest scope documentation, no AI claims, no remote calls.
